adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real mismatch between two guards. In refreshOAuthTokens.ts (line 4), the guard is `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` - requiring userId to be truthy. In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts (line 15), the guard is only `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` - without the userId check. This means when userId is null/falsy (team-owned credentials), refreshOAuthTokens will use the local refresh function, but parseRefreshTokenResponse will still use the minimumTokenResponseSchema instead of the app-specific schema. This could cause valid tokens from the local refresh to be incorrectly parsed/truncated because the wrong schema is applied.
